e7_diagnosis.cause: On P_scalar_fd the end error of every RODAS5P run is the local truncation error of its last step: earlier errors, the DOPRI5 prefix's included, are damped by R(z) ~ -12.4/z (|z| = 1e6 h >= 18 on every step of the route's leg and of R), and the local error of a step of length h on the slow manifold grows like h^3 (one-step grid: slopes 2.9607 to 3.027 for h >= 1e-2; finite-difference derivatives play no part). After its first steps the controller grows each step by its cap 5 because the estimate is far below tolerance, so the last step's length is set by where the ramp from h0 lands before t1, not by the tolerance (the h0 scans at A and L are identical). Rodas5p::solve from t0 with h0 = 1e-3 lands with a short last step (0.219): its error is 0.05692 times the median over h0. The FBP leg, a plain Rodas5p::solve from t_D + H with h0 = H, lands with last steps 0.7433171 (A) and 0.3261414 (L); the same happens without any handover (Rodas5p::solve from t0 with h0 = H: ratio 31.85 at A). E7 failed because its reference R is a lucky step sequence and the rule has no floor; the route has no defect here. Errors in the tolerance unit: N 0.004119489 (A), 2.874489e-07 (L).

run_settings: as V27: every cargo command under the host-wide build lock, taskset -c 0-5,12-17, cargo +1.94.1 --locked -j 4 --release, node-owned CARGO_TARGET_DIR (w4-v30 for N, w4-v30base for T); the evaluation runner is a standalone cargo package router_breakeven_v27b/runner: a copy of router_hyperparameter_free/runner (src/main.rs, its lock with the root package renamed) with the problems above added and an option --h0 (arm R only, for R_H); built once against each checkout; per case and arm one process with --repeat 2 and a fresh process with --repeat 1, entry log on, E5 replay split for N; D and R once more from the T build (sanity); one heavy process at a time; counters and bits only, no wall time; raw stdout, stderr and exit code of every process kept and indexed with UTC start times
order_of_work: 0 (before any deciding run): PHASE2_NOTES.txt with the computation rules; the runner built and checked on the V27 toy problems (toy, toy_stiff, toy_osc, toy_ft, toy_fatal), which are outside this set
1: references (closed forms by mpmath; the others by Rodas5p::solve at rtol 1e-12, atol 1e-14 from the N build)
2: every arm on every case (deciding runs), then R_H
3: RESULTS.json (strict JSON) and REPORT_KO.md from a parser that reads only raw runner output and the references
4: on the N head: unified_breakeven_contracts, unified_router_contracts, default_path_golden, the full facade suite with --no-fail-fast, clippy -D warnings, fmt; default-path golden files unchanged

expectations_without_rule.E7: V27 (raw lines of RESULTS.json): of the 23 cases with a handover and an E7 row, err(N)/err(R) exceeded 3 on 8; E7 failed only on 2 of the 7 of them where DOPRI5 failed (P_scalar_fd at A and L), because elsewhere DOPRI5's error (0.095 to 0.745 tolerance units on the 18 handover cases where it succeeded) set the bar. Here DOPRI5 is expected to fail on kaps_1e6, pendulum_tracker, pre_equilibrium and the two budget variants (A only); by the E7 diagnosis (h0 scan: 31 of 41 step sequences of Rodas5p::solve alone exceed 3 times the default's error on P_scalar_fd) an E7 failure on kaps_1e6 or pre_equilibrium is likely for a reason that is not a defect of the route; R_H is reported to show it
expectations_without_rule.E1: large gains expected where T runs RODAS5P on non-stiff or mildly stiff problems: fput_30 and kuramoto_50 (n > 10), kepler_e09 (today's screen fires at the pericentre start, L about 2000), b1_linear4 (a column norm 1e4 at t0 although the spectral radius is 141), pr_ramp (k(0) = 0: today's screen is silent and the DOPRI5 trial exhausts 1000 attempts); losses as declared above; the geometric means are expected below 1 and N's worst ratio to the better reference near 2 (V27: 1.98)
expectations_without_rule.E2: the budget case chem_d4|A|max_steps=50 is the one where N may fail while T succeeds (DOPRI5 prefix, pilot and RODAS5P ramp from h0 = H within 50 attempts)
expectations_without_rule.E9: pr_sin2t: a few hundred charged right-hand sides (V27 P_scalar_fd: 145 against 181818); a3_linear4: a handover during the initial transient
